hero.filename: Stand With Pike campaign occupation on the access road to Pike River Mine October 2016.jpg
hero.caption: In October 2016 Anna Osborne and Sonya Rockhouse led an occupation of the Pike River Mine access road to stop government mine owner Solid Energy from pouring a 30 metre thick "temporay" concrete seal into the mine's entrance.

images.caption: The coal mine at Brunner on the Grey River, West Coast, was New Zealand's largest. It was the site of New Zealand's largest mine disaster, when 65 men were killed in a mine explosion in 1896. Today it is the site of a restored heritage area, and has memorials to the victims of the explosion and to the Pike River disaster.
